concerns.text: FR-002 requires binning strategy for >2 levels OR flagging ambiguity. Task T012b implements binning, but T012c-FlagAmbiguity is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Without T012c, the 'flag for manual review' path of FR-002 is unimplemented, leaving the spec requirement partially unmet.

FR-003 mandates automatic detection of data structure (between/within) to select the model. Task T021b-ValidateDesign is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Without this task, the system cannot dynamically select the model formula as required by FR-003.

FR-003 requires automatic detection of outcome type (binary vs continuous) to select family. Task T014a is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Without this, the system cannot select the correct regression family (binomial vs gaussian) as mandated.

FR-004 requires VIF calculation and flagging. Task T022 is marked `[X]` (complete) but T022 description says 'Implement... calculate VIF'. However, T022 is listed as `[X]` while T021a (the model fitting that uses VIF context) is `[ ]`. More critically, T023 (extracting coefficients) is `[ ]`. The chain T021a -> T022 -> T023 is broken. T022 alone cannot fulfill FR-004 if the model (T021a) isn't run to generate the design matrix for VIF.
FR-005 requires sensitivity analysis sweep over {2.5, 3.0, 3.5}. Task T030 is marked incomplete `[ ]`. Without T030, the mandatory sensitivity analysis is missing.
FR-006 requires Bonferroni correction for post-hoc comparisons. Task T031 is marked incomplete `[ ]`. This requirement is unmet.
FR-007 requires a forest plot. Task T032 is marked incomplete `[ ]`. This requirement is unmet.

SC-004 (validity of risk-taking measure) requires measuring against simulation parameters. Task T000h-SimulateParams is marked `[X]`, but T023b-SimulationValidation (which validates the parameter recovery) is marked `[ ]`. The validation loop for SC-004 is incomplete.

Task T051 references `structure_config.json` as an alias for `model_config.json`. The spec (FR-003) and plan do not mandate this duplicate artifact. While T051 attempts to align with the plan, the task itself creates a 'stale' artifact requirement not found in the spec, potentially confusing the implementation of the Single Source of Truth (Constitution Principle IV).
